rationale: Crew 15 measured TVOC at 9.99 mg/m3 on the upper floor (sensor maximum; the cited WHO limit is 3 mg/m3) and traced the benzene source to a gasoline tank used as a urine container, so a TVOC sensor was already in use. The mission brief (not the crew) recommends bringing a TVOC meter that separates benzene and formaldehyde and taking a baseline on arrival before sleeping in the hab.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.4 Scientific incidents, lines 695-700, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 78 (air quality monitoring kit: 'VOC/TVOC meter (benzene/formaldehyde)')
